title: coryphantha radians var. pectinata
intro: Coryphantha radians var. pectinata, commonly known as a type of pincushion cactus, is a species of plant in the cactus family, characterized by its unique, pincushion-like appearance. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coryphantha radians var. pectinata include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
